figures.caption: Figure 1: Privacy and causal-fidelity diagnostics for synthetic data. Left: predictive utility (TSTR AUC) and privacy distance (mean DCR) across synthetic datasets. Right: ATEMSE across estimators, with the vertical axis zoomed to emphasize the comparison among the better-performing methods. Hybrid constructions improve causal fidelity substantially relative to fully generative synthetic data, while DCR and TSTR alone do not fully determine causal usefulness.
Table 1: MSE across positivity experiments. Lower is better.
